description: This file defines a simple service method for posting a financial account transaction to the general ledger within the OFBiz framework. It contains a single method 'postFinAccountTransToGl' which orchestrates the posting logic, including setting appropriate accounts based on transaction type, validation, and invoking a service to create accounting entries.

methods.name: postFinAccountTransToGl
methods.description: Service method that processes a financial account transaction and posts it to the general ledger, handling different transaction types and account determination.
